name: Authority-Aware Recovery
description: Recovery operations must respect authority: restore from backup requires approval, credential rotation requires evidence of compromise.
acceptanceCriteria: Backup restore requires explicit approval from an authorized principal.
Credential rotation requires evidence of compromise or scheduled rotation policy.
Recovery operations are logged with full audit trail.
Recovery authority is scoped: a recovery operation cannot exceed the authority of the requestor.
Recovery plans are tested and verified against authority policies.
